 Tuesday's action produced a Boston blowout in the Jayson Tatum vs. Jaylen Brown rivalry, and the Celtics are one of several teams playing the second night of a back-to-back on Wednesday. I’m looking to get back on track after a rough couple of days to open the week, which has taken this season’s record back into the red.

I’m looking to get back on track after a rough couple of days to open the week, which has taken this season’s record back into the red. 
 Dew’s Review: Maybe the Jaylen Brown trade wasn’t a major downgrade for Boston? The Celtics are the No. 1 team in the Eastern Conference at 9-2, and Paul George looked like the best player on the floor in Boston’s blowout over Philly on Tuesday. Joe Mazzulla’s teams have always racked up a ton of regular-season wins, and George looks comfortable in this system. Health is always going to be a concern with the star wing, but he and Tatum are a formidable duo that should keep Boston in the mix for one of the best records in the NBA.

Joe Mazzulla’s teams have always racked up a ton of regular-season wins, and George looks comfortable in this system. Health is always going to be a concern with the star wing, but he and Tatum are a formidable duo that should keep Boston in the mix for one of the best records in the NBA. 
 Peter’s Point: There are a lot of great games to watch on Wednesday, but my eyes have gravitated to Housto, where Kevin Durant and the Rockets (8-3) take on the hottest team in the NBA in the Golden State Warriors. Steph Curry and Co. have won eight games in a row, and they’re set as 6.5-point underdogs in this matchup. The Warriors have suddenly put themselves in the playoff conversation, and it’ll be interesting to see how they stack up against a Houston team that is near the top of the odds to win the NBA Finals. Both of these teams are in the top-five in the league in net rating and offensive rating through the first three weeks of the season.

 There’s one familiar play that I’m taking on Tuesday, but I also have a couple of player props, including one for Curry, who may be a little undervalued against this Houston defense.
